expectations.text: The refusal names what specifically would change the answer, in checkable terms rather than a vague standard like a more established outlet.
expectations.evidence: Every refusal template states a concrete, verifiable condition that would reverse the decision. Template A quotes the failed criterion ("two public pieces on software or cloud development from the last six months") and says "If you send two links that meet it, we'll re-open your application before [date]." Template C reads "send two public pieces by your byline and we'll review it again." Template D reads "Send two bylined articles from the last three months, or an assignment email from the outlet."
